title: Introducing Members Only: Tattoo Supplies for Venue Artists
summary: Venue's new supply shop: cartridges, ink, machines and PPE at member pricing, up to 25% off, for US artists on Venue.
body_markdown:
Cartridges, ink, grips, gloves. Before your client ever sits down costs are coming out of your pocket and you’re paying full price every time you restock.


Members Only changes that. It’s Venue’s new supply shop for tattoo equipment, with member pricing up to 25% off for US artists already using Venue. Members Only carries 60 products from over 20 brands, all ones you've probably already got in your drawer. We don’t stock what you need?[You can tell us here.](https://form.typeform.com/to/f7fVBEjw)


## What's inside?


Cartridges, needles, machines, ink, accessories, supplies, and PPE. Our supplies are bundled so you can save more, so you stock up once every month or two.


Here are five brands to add to your first order:


**Bishop.** The[Power Wand](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FtYoLG1A) comes in liner, shader and packer, with a German-made motor, Bluetooth 5.0 and a one-year warranty. The[XLUMEN](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FtoKsxpg) adds a built-in LED, so your light is part of the machine. Bishop's[Da Vinci V2 cartridges](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FsZEWSfY) were designed by Carlos Torres and Franco Vescovi, with a vent hole for ink flow and a safety membrane against backflow.


**Kwadron.**[Cartridges](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8GNQjds0G) with a full membrane against backflow and a medical-grade plastic housing that cuts friction. Members get up to 25% off the regular price on the cartridges. They also make[traditional needles on a bar](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8whIruU0u48) , individually blister-packed and EO-sterilized, in bundles of 100.


**FK Irons.** The[ONE Adjust](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FvzOXeqm) lets you change stroke length from 2.0 to 5.0mm in 0.5mm steps without powering the machine off. The[Flux Max](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FunUJ9Pc) comes with PowerBolt II batteries. Both carry FK Irons' two-year manufacturer warranty on the machine.


**Dynamic.**[Dynamic Black](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FtBLJLw8) is the original.[Triple Black](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8Ft80NqNM) ,[Union Black](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8wVhV3BRK88) and[BLKout](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8FtBv4uie) cover everything from soft black and grey to solid blackwork.[Greywash sets](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8wpYFDrQuhM) come with four greys and a #00 mixing solution.


**Peak.** The[Torque](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8Fw86Qsu8) has a custom German brushless motor, vibration dampening and a 1.5-inch display with a session timer and hourly-rate tracking. The[Connect V3 battery](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8Fx7yhYVk) works with both the Torque and the Bishop Power Wand.


## Not sure which cartridge? Start with a sampler


A sampler is a mixed pack, so you can compare brands side by side. Pick a[round liner](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8Fwr4Qu5Q) ,[curved mag](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8w8Fx1jWVN2) or[round shader](https://venue.ink/store/products?productId=spr-8wVaUynMBMW) sampler and you get 15 cartridges: five each of Kwadron, Da Vinci V2 and Peak Stellar. Same size, same gauge, so the only thing that changes is the brand. Every cartridge is individually sealed and EO-sterilized.


## How to get in!


Members Only is for US Venue users only at this time.
Sign up for a Venue account, or log in to yours, then open Members Only.
**Venue is free to join.**


[Shop Members Only](https://venue.ink/store)
